name: Match Me If You Can
source:
A crime has been committed.

The killer is hidden in a pub where a speed-dating event is taking place.

Infiltrate the event undercover, casually question the suspects, connect the dots, and arrest the murderer... Unless love turns up to mess with your plans...

Every game has a different murderer, so pay close attention to the clues given at the beginning.

This video game was created during the ARTE GAME JAM 2020.

[From [url=https://pierrec.itch.io/match-me-if-you-can]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一桩命案发生了。

凶手藏在一家正在举办快速约会活动的酒吧里。

你必须乔装潜入，若无其事地询问嫌疑人，串起线索，逮捕凶手……除非，爱情突然冒出来，搅乱你的计划……

每一局的凶手都不同，请仔细留意开场提供的线索。

本作为2020年ARTE GAME JAM游戏创作活动制作。

[摘自[url=https://pierrec.itch.io/match-me-if-you-can]itch.io[/url]]
